name: Cementless THR - Hip Cups
description: Non-cemented titanium acetabular cup with a porous exterior for biological fixation and an internal DLC (Diamond-Like Carbon) coating. Ensures rapid bone ingrowth while minimizing friction and wear against the inlay.
